name: Old Falcon 20
author: JkHuger
description: Neon pill light amber toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from hsl(48,90%,85%) to hsl(198,90%,15%), transform becomes translateX(3em), background-color changes from hsl(48,90%,85%) to hsl(198,90%,55%). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 0.125em , outline becomes transparent.
